# CALTECH ALPINE CLUB ROLES. The jobs th: role
President
column6: Runs the club: calls the meetings, decides what the year looks like, and speaks for the club to Caltech. The job people bring a question to when they do not know who else to ask.

# CALTECH ALPINE CLUB ROLES. The jobs th: Treasurer
column6: Looks after club money. Pays for trips and film festival costs, handles reimbursements, and keeps the accounts straight with Caltech.

# CALTECH ALPINE CLUB ROLES. The jobs th: Secretary
column6: Runs the mailing list and membership: adds people who ask to join, including from outside Caltech, and sends what goes out to members.

# CALTECH ALPINE CLUB ROLES. The jobs th: Film Festival Coordinator
column6: Puts on the club's film festivals. Books the venue, buys the screening license, arranges tickets through the Caltech Ticket Office, and lines up the raffle donations. The club's largest events and the ones that fund most of the rest.

# CALTECH ALPINE CLUB ROLES. The jobs th: Gear Officer
column6: Looks after the equipment the club owns and lends out, including the specialist climbing and packrafting kit that does not go through the Caltech Y. Handles reservations and keeps track of what has come back.

# CALTECH ALPINE CLUB ROLES. The jobs th: Partnerships & Deals Lead
column6: Finds and keeps the discounts members get, and talks to companies about sponsoring the club.

# CALTECH ALPINE CLUB ROLES. The jobs th: Climbing Commodore
column6: Organizes climbing days and looks after the bouldering cave in Brown Gym, including route setting.

# CALTECH ALPINE CLUB ROLES. The jobs th: Hiking and Backpacking Trip Coordinator
column6: Organizes hikes and overnight backpacking trips. Picks where and when, posts it on the calendar, and helps people sort out transport.

# CALTECH ALPINE CLUB ROLES. The jobs th: Trail Run Tyrant
Talks Coordinator
column6: Invites people to give talks on campus about trips they have done, and books a room. A few evenings a year.
